draft.overall: The session's pattern: 9 ran at least 50 percent above the prior close, none gave the entire move back, and 4 kept at least half of the peak gain at the close. NXL ran to 157 percent above the prior close and closed up 76 percent after announcing a definitive 10-year exclusive distribution and local-manufacturing agreement for Brazil and South America. SSM ran to 130 percent above the prior close and closed up 97 percent after a Schedule 13D filing and secondary coverage of Alpine Fox Capital's 21.5% stake in Sono Group. After the close, AMOD was up 62 percent following its reported completion of an asset transaction and secondary coverage of a PIPE delivering 3,170 Bitcoin valued above $250 million. Fresh news was found in our sources for 7 of the 12 names the desk covers; NXL closed at $7.55, with a $10.98 session high, stored support at $4.90, stored resistance at $10.98, and open supply from a recent offering (active), warrants (possibly active), convertibles (possibly active), and atm (possibly active). The desk covers 12 names into the next session.
